identity.ref: vLEI credential naming the legal entity and the treasurer's delegation

runtime.inference_provider: sovereign inference inside the jurisdiction, zero retention

permitted_universe.ref: regulated dollar stablecoin on the permitted rail
operating accounts at the regulated custodian

operational: sweep surplus into the money-market fund and back as obligations fall due

tactical: any ticket above the escalation threshold

Token-level transfer hooks and attestation on the execution rail

audit.format: Immutable on-chain record of every step; pre-trade compliance decisions logged
